budget_excludes: Only genuinely idle time waiting for the shared CPU lock; overlapping useful work is counted
metric: median microseconds per sieve; smaller is better
protocol: Independent agents with no inherited conversation; identical baseline, information, model and work budget. No sharing of optimization discoveries until both branches are frozen. Batch uses fresh SBCL processes; interactive uses a persistent native SBCL REPL. Final checks and comparison use fresh images.
budget_accounting: Only genuinely idle wait time can be deducted; a blocked subprocess while reading, editing or reasoning does not stop the active-work clock. Both agents elected to keep their original wall-clock deadlines unless future genuine inactivity is explicitly recorded.
independent_verifier: verify-final.lisp: full primality flags, counts, class instances, instance independence, boundary cases and sizes through 2,000,003; baseline passed.
selection_basis: Smallest median in the fixed final comparison; 2.1% observed time advantage, overlapping sample ranges; no conclusive superiority of a development method.
